en.shortDescription: Open-source OpenTelemetry APM and observability platform
en.longDescription:
SigNoz is an open-source APM and observability platform built on OpenTelemetry with ClickHouse storage.

Includes ZooKeeper, ClickHouse, migrator, collector, and UI. OTLP ingestion on ports 4317 and 4318. JWT secret uses SERVICE_HEX_64_SIGNOZ.
